<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_617936_service_1_service_request_case</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Apollo Service Request Event Trigger</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    var email = '';
    var name = '';
    if (current.consumer) {
        email = current.consumer.email.toString();
        name = current.consumer.name.toString();
    }

    // 1. On insert -> case_received
    if (current.operation() == 'insert') {
        gs.eventQueue('x_2223823_apollo_0.case_received', current, email, name);
        gs.eventQueue('x_hospital.case_received', current, email, name);
    }
    // 2. On state change -> case_update
    else if (current.state.changes()) {
        gs.eventQueue('x_2223823_apollo_0.case_update', current, email, name);
        gs.eventQueue('x_hospital.case_update', current, email, name);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>integration.user</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-20 11:53:57</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>23ab752747605790273a565a516d439e</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Apollo Service Request Event Trigger</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Apollo-Hospitals" source="x_2223823_apollo_0">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Apollo-Hospitals">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_23ab752747605790273a565a516d439e</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>integration.user</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-20 11:53:57</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=23ab752747605790273a565a516d439e"/></record_update>
